home.title: Taketora｜Antique Shop in Kyoto Higashiyama - Antiques, Anime Figures & Pokémon Cards
home.description: Three shops in Higashiyama, Kyoto, near Kiyomizu-dera. Japanese pottery, tea ceremony tools, old tools and hanging scrolls, plus anime figures and Pokémon cards. Open every day 10:00–20:00, English spoken.

antique.title: Japanese Antiques & Old Tools｜Taketora Kyoto Higashiyama
antique.description: Kiyomizu, Imari and Kutani ware, tea ceremony tools, iron kettles, old chests, hanging scrolls and ukiyo-e, sold in store at Taketora in Higashiyama, Kyoto. Walkable from Kiyomizu-dera.

animeFigures.title: Anime Figures in Kyoto｜Taketora Higashiyama
animeFigures.description: Anime figures in stock at Taketora in Higashiyama, Kyoto: mostly prize figures from One Piece, Dragon Ball, Demon Slayer and more. Second-hand pieces are graded by condition.

pokemon.title: Pokémon Cards in Kyoto｜Taketora Higashiyama
pokemon.description: Sealed Pokémon card booster boxes and more at Taketora in Higashiyama, Kyoto. DM us on Instagram to check stock before you visit.

collection.title: All Items｜Taketora Kyoto - Figures, Antiques & Pokémon Cards
collection.description: Items in stock at Taketora antique shop in Higashiyama, Kyoto, with prices and condition. Stock updates every minute.
